subject.title: [Feature]: support SecretRef for channel phone numbers as it's Personal Identifiable Information (PII)

question: Should supported channel phone-number and sender-identity config fields accept SecretRef values, and must unresolved SecretRefs be resolved before satisfying allowlist or open-policy checks?
rationale: This changes security-sensitive config semantics across channel boundaries and needs maintainer intent on the privacy benefit, compatibility contract, and access-control behavior before acceptance.

options.title: Allow SecretRef with resolved-policy checks
options.body: Accept the feature only when plain strings remain valid, SecretRefs resolve before access decisions, and docs/metadata/redaction/tests cover the supported channel surfaces.

options.title: Narrow the supported surface
options.body: Limit the first change to the highest-risk supported fields and leave lower-priority channels for follow-up issues or plugin-owned work.

options.title: Defer the config expansion
options.body: Keep phone-number fields plaintext-only for now and document that users should avoid committing channel configs containing phone numbers.

recommendation.title: Allow SecretRef with resolved-policy checks
recommendation.body: Accept the feature only when plain strings remain valid, SecretRefs resolve before access decisions, and docs/metadata/redaction/tests cover the supported channel surfaces.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already provided the most detailed current-main review and has recent history across the relevant voice-call, WhatsApp, and SecretRef registry surfaces.
